𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐟𝐟𝐢𝐜 𝐀𝐝𝐯𝐢𝐬𝐨𝐫𝐲

In connection with “SHAB-E-QADAR” JAAGNE KI RAATH, in the intervening night of 16/17-03-2026, to ensure better road safety and to avert any untoward incident/road accidents, two wheelers will not be allowed on the flyovers at 1) Dr.Manmohan Singh Express Flyover (Zoo Park to Aramghar flyover), 2) Bahadurpura Flyover (Devi Bagh to Zoo Park gate no.2), 3) Chandrayangutta flyover (Entrance from Nayara Petrol pump Hashamabad to Phoolbagh DLRL) and 4) Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Flyover (Pisalbanda to Laxma Reddy Garden Function Hall) after 10.00 p.m.,.

General public/commuters are requested to make note of above restrictions and co-operate with the Traffic Police.

In case of any inconvenience in commuting, please contact traffic helpline 9010203626.

Jt. Commissioner of Police,
Traffic, Hyderabad.

data.raw_text:
One thing I will never get tired of doing: giving Rena Wakama her flowers, especially when she deserves every single one.

She stepped into the head coaching role with very little experience, and like some other Nigerians, I was skeptical about her chances of succeeding with D'Tigress when she was appointed. Right now she's improved a lot, her adjustments, intensity, and leadership have elevated the team to elite levels fast

Just had to say this after watching how Nigeria fought back to beat Philippines. Our game proved she's light-years ahead in this coaching game.

Nigeria trailed 42-51 at halftime (down 9), then exploded in the 3rd and 4th quarters, dropping 34 then 25 points, to smash them 101-84. Whatever she told the players at the break lit a massive fire. (Big ups to the squad for executing it too!)

Nigeria better start scouting her replacement now. A bigger team is coming to sign Rena soon.

Keep killing it, Coach!

#ballchatwithkenny #fibawwcq
